title: Migrate proof retention to per-kind days

fields.summary: As a quality architect, I want retention_days migrated to a retention per artifact kind, so that existing configs keep their meaning.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [api-trace] state: a config with `[proof] retention_days = 90`; expected: `aayu config show` reports 90 days for every kind after the migration
2. [api-trace] state: `aayu upgrade` on that config, then its rollback; expected: the file is restored byte for byte
fields.scenario: Load a v1 config, run the migration, show the config, then roll the migration back.
fields.environment: local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production
